title: cellchat input schema
description: JSON schema for params.json passed to cellchat.R via BioF3 dispatcher. Compatible with biof3-r-runtime CellChat>=1.6.0 + Seurat>=5.0.

seurat_rds.description: Filename of Seurat RDS object in jobDir (or absolute path). Must exist and be >1KB; meta.data must contain cell_type_col.

cell_type_col.description: Column in Seurat meta.data containing cell type labels used as cellchat group.by.

db_category.description: subsetDB(search = ...) filter; 'all' keeps the full DB.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per group required to compute communications; used by computeCommunProb and filterCommunication.

pvalue_threshold.description: p-value cutoff for permutation test in computeCommunProb.

n_patterns.description: Number of NMF latent patterns for identifyCommunicationPatterns (only used when compute_hierarchy=true).

compute_hierarchy.description: Whether to run selectK + identifyCommunicationPatterns + netAnalysis_signalingRole (slow).
